mapper.sql: id, andon_type_id, reason_id, work_center, production_line, equipment_id, work_order_id, description, status, severity, reporter, handler, report_time, confirm_time, resolve_time, resolve_desc, duration, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO andon_record (andon_type_id, reason_id, work_center, production_line, equipment_id, work_order_id, description, status, severity, reporter, handler, report_time) VALUES (#{andonTypeId}, #{reasonId}, #{workCenter}, #{productionLine}, #{equipmentId}, #{workOrderId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{severity}, #{reporter}, #{handler}, #{reportTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE andon_record SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM andon_record WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM andon_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('REPORTED', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'REPORTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 2 END, report_time ASC
